blocks.text: Bu dars 83-darsning teskarisi: «ko'p» o'rniga «oz». O'zbek tilida «oz», «kam», «ozgina» hamma narsa bilan ishlatiladi: **ozgina** suv, **bir nechta** kitob. Ingliz tilida yana ot turi muhim: sanalmaydigan ot bilan — **little** (much ning juftligi), sanaladigan otning ko'pligi bilan — **few** (many ning juftligi). Bundan tashqari, oldida **a** bor-yo'qligi ma'noni o'zgartiradi.

**a little** — «ozgina», «biroz»: narsa oz, lekin **bor**: **a little** milk, **a little** time, **a little** help. Otsiz ham: Do you speak English? — **A little**. Sifat va fe'l bilan **a little** = «biroz», «sal»: I'm **a little** tired. Wait **a little**. Sanaladigan ot bilan «a little» ishlatilmaydi: «a little books» emas — **a few** books.

items.text: Put **a little** butter on the bread.
The room is **a little** dark — can you open the curtains?

blocks.text: **a few** — «bir nechta», «bir-ikkita»: soni oz, lekin **bor**: **a few** days, **a few** friends, **a few** questions. Ot har doim ko'plikda. Otsiz ham: I've got **a few**. Sanalmaydigan ot bilan «a few» ishlatilmaydi: «a few money» emas — **a little** money.

items.text: I need **a few** stamps for these postcards.
items.translation: Bu otkritkalar uchun **bir nechta** marka kerak.

items.text: We met **a few** nice people on the train to Bukhara.
items.translation: Buxoroga ketayotgan poyezdda **bir nechta** yoqimli odam bilan tanishdik.

blocks.text: a little ↔ little, a few ↔ few — muhim farq

**a** bilan — **ijobiy** ma'no: oz, lekin bor va bu yetarli bo'lishi mumkin («ozgina bor»). **a** siz — **salbiy** ma'no: juda kam, deyarli yo'q, yetarli emas («juda kam», «sanoqli»). Ya'ni **little** = not much, **few** = not many. So'zlashuvda yolg'iz **little / few** kitobiyroq eshitiladi, shuning uchun ko'pincha **very little / very few** deyiladi.

rows: I've got **a little** money. Let's go to a café.
Biroz pulim bor — kafega borsa bo'ladi (ijobiy).
I've got **very little** money. I can't go out.
Tom has **a few** friends in London.
Tomning Londonda bir nechta do'sti bor (yolg'iz emas).

items.text: There are **a few** apples left — let's make a pie.
There are **very few** apples left — we need to buy some.
items.translation: Olma **juda kam** qolibdi — sotib olishimiz kerak.

blocks.text: only a little, only a few

**only a little** / **only a few** — «atigi ozgina», «atigi bir nechta»: miqdor kamligini ta'kidlaydi, lekin **a** saqlanadi: **Only a few** people came. **Only a little** soup is left. Bu shakl so'zlashuvda yolg'iz **few / little** dan ko'ra ko'proq ishlatiladi.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «a few money» → **a little money**; «a little books» → **a few books**; «a few water» → **a little water**; «I speak few English» («ozgina» ma'nosida) → **I speak a little English** (few — sanaladigan va salbiy); «He has little friends» → **He has few friends**; «a few book» → **a few books** (ot ko'plikda).

Eslab qolish: **little** — **much** bilan (sanalmaydi), **few** — **many** bilan (sanaladi). **a** bor — narsa ham **bor**, oz bo'lsa ham: a little, a few. **a** yo'q — narsa ham **deyarli yo'q**: little, few.

Bog'liq darslar: **much / many / a lot of** → 83-dars; sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan otlar → 67–68-darslar; qiyosiy daraja oldida **a little** (a little bigger — biroz kattaroq) → 88-dars; **too little / too few** → 92-dars.

examples.title: **a little** + uncountable nouns
examples.description: **a little** — sanalmaydigan ot bilan: «ozgina», «biroz» (oz bo'lsa ham, bor): **a little** milk, **a little** time. Ijobiy ma'no.

sentences.text: Could I have **a little** milk in my tea, please?
sentences.translation: Choyimga **ozgina** sut qo'shib bera olasizmi?

sentences.text: We've still got **a little** time before the film starts.
sentences.translation: Film boshlanishiga hali **biroz** vaqtimiz bor.

sentences.text: Add **a little** salt and pepper to the soup.
sentences.translation: Sho'rvaga **ozgina** tuz va qalampir qo'shing.

sentences.text: Bekzod has saved **a little** money for his holiday.
sentences.translation: Bekzod ta'til uchun **biroz** pul yig'di.

sentences.text: There's **a little** bread left — shall I make you a sandwich?
sentences.translation: **Ozgina** non qolibdi — sizga sendvich qilib beraymi?

sentences.text: Madina needs **a little** help with her maths homework.
sentences.translation: Madinaga matematika uy vazifasida **ozgina** yordam kerak.

sentences.text: I usually put **a little** honey in my yoghurt.
sentences.translation: Odatda yogurtimga **ozgina** asal solaman.

sentences.text: With **a little** practice, you'll be able to drive in the city.
sentences.translation: **Biroz** mashq qilsangiz, shaharda mashina hayday olasiz.

sentences.text: The doctor told Aziz to drink **a little** water every hour.
sentences.translation: Shifokor Azizga har soatda **ozgina** suv ichishni aytdi.

sentences.text: We had **a little** snow in Tashkent last night, and the children were so happy.
sentences.translation: Kecha kechasi Toshkentga **ozgina** qor yog'di, bolalar juda xursand bo'lishdi.

examples.title: **a few** + plural nouns
examples.description: **a few** — sanaladigan otning ko'pligi bilan: «bir nechta», «bir-ikkita» (oz bo'lsa ham, bor): **a few** days, **a few** questions.

sentences.text: I'm going to Samarkand for **a few** days.
sentences.translation: **Bir necha** kunga Samarqandga ketyapman.

sentences.text: Can I ask you **a few** questions?
sentences.translation: Sizga **bir nechta** savol bersam maylimi?

sentences.text: **A few** friends are coming round this evening.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun **bir nechta** do'stim kelyapti.

sentences.text: We stopped in **a few** small villages on the way to Khiva.
sentences.translation: Xivaga ketayotib **bir nechta** kichik qishloqda to'xtadik.

sentences.text: Tom knows **a few** words of Uzbek.
sentences.translation: Tom o'zbekchada **bir nechta** so'z biladi.

sentences.text: There are **a few** biscuits in the cupboard if you're hungry.
sentences.translation: Qorningiz och bo'lsa, shkafda **bir nechta** pechenye bor.

sentences.text: Emma lived in Tashkent **a few** years ago.
sentences.translation: Emma **bir necha** yil oldin Toshkentda yashagan.

sentences.text: The bus will be here in **a few** minutes.
sentences.translation: Avtobus **bir necha** daqiqada keladi.

sentences.text: I've made **a few** mistakes, but the teacher says my essay is good.
sentences.translation: **Bir nechta** xato qildim, lekin o'qituvchi inshoyim yaxshi deydi.

sentences.text: Dilnoza bought **a few** souvenirs for her colleagues in London.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza Londondagi hamkasblariga **bir nechta** esdalik sovg'a oldi.

examples.title: Without a noun: Yes, **a little**. / I'm **a little** tired.
examples.description: Otsiz ham: Do you speak Russian? — **A little**. I know **a few**. Sifat va fe'l bilan **a little** = «biroz», «sal»: **a little** tired, rest **a little**.

sentences.text: Do you speak Russian? — Yes, **a little**.
sentences.translation: Ruscha gapirasizmi? — Ha, **ozgina**.

sentences.text: I'm **a little** tired after the journey.
sentences.translation: Yo'ldan keyin **biroz** charchadim.

sentences.text: Do you know any good cafés here? — Yes, I know **a few**.
sentences.translation: Bu yerda yaxshi kafelarni bilasizmi? — Ha, **bir nechtasini** bilaman.

sentences.text: The soup is **a little** salty, but it's still delicious.
sentences.translation: Sho'rva **biroz** sho'r, lekin baribir mazali.

sentences.text: Madina was **a little** nervous before her first lesson.
sentences.translation: Madina birinchi darsidan oldin **biroz** hayajonlandi.

sentences.text: Have we got any eggs? — Yes, **a few**. I'll make an omelette.
sentences.translation: Tuxum bormi? — Ha, **bir nechta** bor. Omlet qilaman.

sentences.text: Can you turn the music down **a little**? I'm trying to sleep.
sentences.translation: Musiqani **biroz** pasaytira olasizmi? Uxlamoqchiman.

sentences.text: I didn't eat all the cherries — I only had **a few**.
sentences.translation: Gilosning hammasini yemadim — faqat **bir nechtasini** yedim.

sentences.text: Sit down and rest **a little** — you look very hot.
sentences.translation: O'tirib **biroz** dam oling — juda qizib ketganga o'xshaysiz.

sentences.text: Aziz understands English quite well, and he speaks it **a little** too.
sentences.translation: Aziz inglizchani ancha yaxshi tushunadi, **ozgina** gapira ham oladi.

examples.title: **little** / **very little** — almost nothing
examples.description: **a** siz **little** — salbiy ma'no: «juda kam, deyarli yo'q» (= not much). So'zlashuvda ko'pincha **very little**: We have **very little** time.

sentences.text: Hurry up! We have **very little** time.
sentences.translation: Tezroq! Vaqtimiz **juda kam**.

sentences.text: There was **little** water in the river after the hot summer.
sentences.translation: Issiq yozdan keyin daryoda suv **juda kam** edi.

sentences.text: My grandfather eats **very little** in the evening.
sentences.translation: Bobom kechqurun **juda kam** ovqat yeydi.

sentences.text: Aziz has **little** interest in football — he prefers chess.
sentences.translation: Azizni futbol **deyarli qiziqtirmaydi** — u shaxmatni afzal ko'radi.

sentences.text: We had **very little** rain this spring, so the fields are dry.
sentences.translation: Bu bahor yomg'ir **juda kam** yog'di, shuning uchun dalalar qurg'oq.

sentences.text: Sarah knows **very little** about Uzbek history.
sentences.translation: Sara O'zbekiston tarixi haqida **juda kam** narsa biladi.

sentences.text: The new manager has **little** experience, but he learns fast.
sentences.translation: Yangi menejerning tajribasi **juda kam**, lekin u tez o'rganadi.

sentences.text: There's **very little** milk left — we need to buy some.
sentences.translation: Sut **juda kam** qolibdi — sotib olishimiz kerak.

sentences.text: I slept **very little** last night because of the noise.
sentences.translation: Shovqin tufayli kecha **juda kam** uxladim.

sentences.text: Dilnoza spends **very little** money on clothes.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza kiyimga **juda kam** pul sarflaydi.

examples.title: **few** / **very few** — almost none
examples.description: **a** siz **few** — salbiy ma'no: «juda kam, sanoqli» (= not many). So'zlashuvda ko'pincha **very few**: **Very few** tourists come in winter.

sentences.text: **Very few** tourists visit the village in winter.
sentences.translation: Qishda qishloqqa **juda kam** sayyoh keladi.

sentences.text: Tom has **few** friends because he's very shy.
sentences.translation: Tomning do'stlari **juda kam**, chunki u juda uyatchan.

sentences.text: There are **very few** shops open after ten o'clock.
sentences.translation: Soat o'ndan keyin ochiq do'konlar **juda kam**.

sentences.text: **Few** people know that Madina writes poems.
sentences.translation: Madinaning she'r yozishini **kamdan-kam** odam biladi.

sentences.text: The exam was so hard that **very few** students passed.
sentences.translation: Imtihon shunchalik qiyin ediki, **juda kam** talaba o'tdi.

sentences.text: My grandmother has **very few** teeth, so she eats soft food.
sentences.translation: Buvimning tishlari **juda kam** qolgan, shuning uchun u yumshoq ovqat yeydi.

sentences.text: Bekzod made **very few** mistakes in his English test.
sentences.translation: Bekzod ingliz tili testida **juda kam** xato qildi.

sentences.text: In our village, **few** families have a car.
sentences.translation: Qishlog'imizda **sanoqli** oilalarning mashinasi bor.

sentences.text: We waited for a taxi, but **very few** cars passed.
sentences.translation: Taksi kutdik, lekin **juda kam** mashina o'tdi.

sentences.text: Emma has lived in Oxford for years, but she has **very few** English friends.
sentences.translation: Emma yillardan beri Oksfordda yashaydi, lekin ingliz do'stlari **juda kam**.

examples.title: **a little** ↔ **little**, **a few** ↔ **few**
examples.description: **a** bilan — ijobiy: oz, lekin bor. **a** siz — salbiy: juda kam, yetarli emas. I've got **a little** money (biroz pulim bor) ↔ I've got **very little** money (pulim juda kam).

sentences.text: I've got **a little** money — let's have a coffee.
sentences.translation: **Biroz** pulim bor — qahva ichaylik.

sentences.text: I've got **very little** money, so I can't go out tonight.
sentences.translation: Pulim **juda kam**, shuning uchun bugun kechqurun hech qayerga chiqa olmayman.

sentences.text: Aziz has **a few** friends in London, so he isn't lonely.
sentences.translation: Azizning Londonda **bir nechta** do'sti bor, shuning uchun u yolg'izlik his qilmaydi.

sentences.text: Bekzod has **few** friends in London, and he feels lonely.
sentences.translation: Bekzodning Londonda do'stlari **juda kam**, u o'zini yolg'iz his qiladi.

sentences.text: There's **a little** time left — we can still catch the train.
sentences.translation: Hali **biroz** vaqt bor — poyezdga ulgurishimiz mumkin.

sentences.text: There's **very little** time left — we're going to miss the train!
sentences.translation: Vaqt **juda kam** qoldi — poyezdga ulgurmaymiz!

sentences.text: **A few** people came to the lecture, and it was quite interesting.
sentences.translation: Ma'ruzaga **bir nechta** odam keldi, ancha qiziqarli bo'ldi.

sentences.text: **Very few** people came to the lecture, so the teacher cancelled it.
sentences.translation: Ma'ruzaga **juda kam** odam keldi, shuning uchun o'qituvchi uni bekor qildi.

sentences.text: Madina speaks **a little** English, so she can order food in a restaurant.
sentences.translation: Madina **ozgina** inglizcha biladi, shuning uchun restoranda ovqat buyurtma qila oladi.

sentences.text: Her mother speaks **very little** English, so she needs a translator.
sentences.translation: Onasi inglizchani **juda kam** biladi, shuning uchun unga tarjimon kerak.

examples.title: Cooking soup: **a little** oil, **a few** potatoes
examples.description: Oshxonadagi suhbat: sanalmaydigan narsalar bilan **a little** (oil, salt), sanaladiganlar bilan **a few** (carrots, potatoes), salbiy **very few** va otsiz **a little**.

sentences.text: — Mum, I want to cook soup. Can you give me **a few** tips?
sentences.translation: — Oyi, sho'rva pishirmoqchiman. **Bir nechta** maslahat bera olasizmi?

sentences.text: — Of course. First, heat **a little** oil in a big pot.
sentences.translation: — Albatta. Avval katta qozonda **ozgina** yog' qizdir.

sentences.text: — Like this? Just **a little**?
sentences.translation: — Mana shundaymi? **Ozginami**?

sentences.text: — Yes, good. Now cut **a few** carrots and two onions.
sentences.translation: — Ha, yaxshi. Endi **bir nechta** sabzi va ikkita piyoz to'g'ra.

sentences.text: — We've got **very few** carrots — only two.
sentences.translation: — Sabzimiz **juda kam** — atigi ikkita.

sentences.text: — That's fine. Add **a few** potatoes then.
sentences.translation: — Mayli. Unda **bir nechta** kartoshka qo'sh.

sentences.text: — Should I add **a little** salt now?
sentences.translation: — Hozir **ozgina** tuz qo'shaymi?

sentences.text: — Yes, but only **a little** — you can add more later.
sentences.translation: — Ha, lekin faqat **ozgina** — keyin yana qo'shsa bo'ladi.

sentences.text: — It smells great! Can I try **a little**?
sentences.translation: — Hidi zo'r! **Ozgina** tatib ko'rsam maylimi?

sentences.text: — Wait **a few** minutes — the potatoes aren't soft yet.
sentences.translation: — **Bir necha** daqiqa kut — kartoshka hali yumshamadi.

examples.title: Mixed practice: **(a) little** or **(a) few**?
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: sanalmaydigan ot bilan **(a) little**, sanaladigan bilan **(a) few**; **a** bilan ijobiy, **a** siz (very) — salbiy ma'no; **only a few**.

sentences.text: Can I have **a little** more rice, please?
sentences.translation: Iltimos, yana **ozgina** guruch bersangiz.

sentences.text: Because of the snow, **only a few** students came to class.
sentences.translation: Qor tufayli darsga **atigi bir nechta** talaba keldi.

sentences.text: Sarah has **very little** free time since she started her new job.
sentences.translation: Sara yangi ishni boshlaganidan beri bo'sh vaqti **juda kam**.

sentences.text: We stayed in Bukhara for **a few** days and then went to Khiva.
sentences.translation: Buxoroda **bir necha** kun qoldik, keyin Xivaga ketdik.

sentences.text: There were **very few** cars on the road early in the morning.
sentences.translation: Erta tongda yo'lda mashinalar **juda kam** edi.

sentences.text: I know **a little** about cars, so I can check the engine for you.
sentences.translation: Mashinalar haqida **biroz** bilaman, shuning uchun dvigatelni tekshirib bera olaman.

sentences.text: James is **a little** worried about his exam tomorrow.
sentences.translation: Jeyms ertangi imtihoni haqida **biroz** xavotirda.

sentences.text: Madina has **few** relatives in Tashkent — most of them live in Fergana.
sentences.translation: Madinaning Toshkentda qarindoshlari **juda kam** — ko'pchiligi Farg'onada yashaydi.

sentences.text: Could you lend me **a few** pounds until tomorrow?
sentences.translation: Ertagacha **bir necha** funt qarz berib tura olasizmi?

sentences.text: There's **very little** we can do now — let's wait for the doctor.
sentences.translation: Hozir qo'limizdan **deyarli hech narsa** kelmaydi — shifokorni kutaylik.
